key_insight: Hybrid Lattices connect regular Fourier grids to asymptotically self-similar cascade grids, preserving triadic interactions across many scales.
engineering_relevance: The framework could extend the scale range of turbulence simulations while retaining regular-grid resolution of large-scale coherent structures.
method: Start with a regular Fourier-space region for large-scale structures.
Extend it using recurrence relations, such as Fibonacci, while keeping wavevector components on the original grid.
Add boundary ghost points to improve energy transfer into the recurrent region.
evidence_signal: The framework is tested on the one-dimensional Burgers equation and two-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes turbulence; the abstract provides no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: A sharp reduction in cross-region triads causes an energy-transfer bottleneck, making the boundary ghost-point treatment important.
paper_title: Turbulence on Hybrid Lattices: regular grids meet self similar cascade models
